description: This file defines the 'Upgrade' class within the Opencart installation model, providing methods for database schema modifications such as adding records, retrieving records, checking table and field existence, and dropping tables and fields.

classes.name: Upgrade
classes.description: Provides database schema upgrade and management functionalities such as adding records, retrieving data, and schema modifications.

methods.name: addRecord
methods.description: Inserts a new record into a specified database table, handling multiple data types.

methods.name: getRecords
methods.description: Retrieves all records from a specified database table.

methods.name: hasTable
methods.description: Checks whether a specific table exists in the database schema.

methods.name: hasField
methods.description: Checks whether a specific field exists in a particular table.

methods.name: dropTable
methods.description: Drops a specified table if it exists.

methods.name: dropField
methods.description: Drops a specified field from a table if it exists.
